scope: committed prior-clock source freeze before fresh fixture and real fitting

history_cutoff.selection: supported earlier source order AND strictly earlier period/game clock
history_cutoff.same_clock: ignore every row including faceoff, reset, review and unknown kind before examining its contents
history_cutoff.phase: coarsened recorded prior-clock proxy; current membership retained; no recovered physical uninterrupted-play claim
history_cutoff.period: history is within the focal period; known earlier periods are outside it, unknown prior period is a barrier
history_cutoff.phase_boundary: supported prior reset gives known absence; supported faceoff or action after a known reset starts a known recorded phase; unanchored live history is censored
history_cutoff.known_absence: empty known phase participants; complete current-unit-only proxy candidates
history_cutoff.unknown: unknown clock/order/kind or censored phase remains unavailable until a supported earlier reset/anchor
history_cutoff.transition: shared native membership algebra at strict before-clock query; includes interval returns r<t without intervening events, excludes r==t
history_cutoff.transition_evidence: supported native intervals plus selected earlier source reset/clock facts; no per-event elapsed association prerequisite

public_interfaces: unchanged; annual state schema unchanged; no old recipe compatibility
preservation: original captures, prepared evidence, old numerical families and primary draft files unchanged
